name: odd-rendering-compiler
description: Build-time pipeline: TEI ODD Processing Model → CSS, XSLT, unified/xast handlers, and CETEIcean behaviours — with end-to-end HTML rendering for static editions

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:xslt && npm run build:unified && npm run build:ceteicean
scripts.render:script: node render-unified.mjs --enhance script --handlers output/tei-handlers.mjs --tei "../examples/simler-*.xml" --css output/edition.css --out output/unified-script
scripts.render:islands: node render-unified.mjs --enhance islands --handlers output/tei-handlers.mjs --tei "../examples/simler-*.xml" --css output/edition.css --out output/unified-islands
scripts.render:petite-vue: node render-unified.mjs --enhance petite-vue --handlers output/tei-handlers.mjs --tei "../examples/simler-*.xml" --css output/edition.css --out output/unified-petite-vue
scripts.render:all: npm run render:xslt && npm run render:unified && npm run render:script && npm run render:islands && npm run render:petite-vue && npm run render:plain && npm run render:search && npm run render:json
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run build:unified && npm run render:unified && npm run render:script
scripts.build:extension: node odd-to-css.mjs --odd ../examples/extensions/nested-pb/tei_simler-nested-pb.odd --tokens ../examples/design-tokens.css --out output/nested-pb && node odd-to-unified.mjs --odd ../examples/extensions/nested-pb/tei_simler-nested-pb.odd --out output/nested-pb --strict

author: Christian Forney
